project.name: example-experiment-control-agent
project.description: Replace this with your project objective.

method_exploration.purpose: Explore early-stage research ideas by proposing, prototyping, and testing candidate methods.
entry_conditions: the project does not yet have fixed target rows or a mature candidate method
the next useful step is to generate or refine hypotheses
small prototypes, ablations, or sanity checks can provide useful evidence
required_reads: configured project policy and cycle brief
active managed jobs and available resources
allowed_actions: propose one to three candidate hypotheses
rank candidates by expected information gain and cost
implement a minimal prototype or experiment variant inside writable workspaces
launch bounded smoke tests, toy runs, ablations, or small-scale evaluations
revise, reject, or promote candidate methods from evidence
required_artifacts: evidence path for the prototype, analysis, or run
promote, revise, reject, or continue decision
updated status, journal, and lane note
success_criteria: one candidate method is made more or less credible using evidence
the next research step is more specific than before
the agent avoids broad undirected search and records why the chosen probe was informative
escalation_criteria: the research objective is too vague to propose a testable hypothesis
no safe writable workspace exists for a prototype or probe
the next useful idea requires domain knowledge or data access outside the configured profile

audit_validation.purpose: Validate data, metrics, runners, provenance, and safety assumptions before trusting or promoting work.
entry_conditions: failure cause, data provenance, leakage risk, or command mapping is unclear
a candidate method needs preflight validation before full execution
completed evidence may be inconsistent, incomparable, or unsafe to use
required_reads: configured project policy and cycle brief
the specific artifact, command, dataset, or metric under audit
allowed_actions: candidate package design without launching if evidence is insufficient
required_artifacts: updated status, journal, and lane note
success_criteria: the next safe action is more specific than before
unsafe or incomparable evidence is not promoted
escalation_criteria: the next step needs user-only context
safe write boundaries or trusted evidence sources are unclear
the required validation cannot be performed from available workspaces

target_recovery.purpose: Recover or improve predefined target results using reproducible evidence.
entry_conditions: target rows, metrics, or acceptance criteria are already defined
there is enough project context to choose result-bearing candidates
the user values progress toward targets more than additional open-ended exploration
required_reads: configured project policy and cycle brief
target dashboard or equivalent project reference
active managed jobs and watched results
allowed_actions: rank open targets by urgency and evidence gap
launch documented full or remaining-fold/result-bearing packages
launch executable unblocking audits when a target is not ready
update target state from completed evidence
required_artifacts: hypothesis and command for each launched package
updated status, journal, and target/lane ledger
success_criteria: at least one open target receives a concrete push or a true blocker
failed candidates do not silently close the target
result-bearing work is preferred when evidence is sufficient
escalation_criteria: all open targets are blocked by external dependencies
target metrics or acceptance criteria are ambiguous
the next recovery step would require unsafe or destructive changes
